definitions.explanation: A written acknowledgment that something has been received, especially payment.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}の{受取|うけとり}は{窓口|まどぐち}でお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please pick up your package at the counter.

examples.japanese: {受取|うけとり}{金額|きんがく}を{確認|かくにん}してください。

notes:
USAGE: {受取|うけとり} can refer to both the document (receipt) and the act of receiving.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{受取|うけとり}を{書|か}く (to write a receipt)
・{受取|うけとり}を{発行|はっこう}する (to issue a receipt)
・{受取|うけとり}{証|しょう} (receipt, acknowledgment)
・{受取|うけとり}{人|にん} (recipient, addressee)

WRITING VARIATIONS: Can also be written as {受け取り|うけとり}.

RELATED:
・レシート - receipt (from English, for store purchases)
・{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} - official receipt (more formal)
